components.name: Embedded Linux Base Platform
components.description: 임베디드 리눅스 배포 기반 계층. 커널, 부트로더, 루트 파일시스템을 포함한다.

components.name: OpenSSH
components.description: 원격 관리 및 안전한 파일 전송에 사용되는 SSH 서버/클라이언트.

components.name: libxml2
components.description: IEC 61850 SCL, PLCopen XML 등 설정 파일 파싱에 사용하는 XML 처리기.

components.name: wpa_supplicant
components.description: 무선 백홀 링크의 WPA2/WPA3 인증 및 키 교환을 수행하는 서플리컨트.

components.name: Eclipse Mosquitto
components.description: 엣지 계층의 MQTT 브로커. 현장 데이터를 상위 시스템으로 발행한다.

components.name: BusyBox
components.description: 임베디드 리눅스 기본 유틸리티 모음. 부팅 스크립트와 진단 셸 명령을 제공한다.

components.name: dnsmasq
components.description: 셀 네트워크 내부의 DNS 캐시 및 DHCP 주소 할당 서비스.

components.name: Magelis Configuration Store Service
components.description: 프로젝트 설정, 태그 정의, 사용자 계정 정보를 영구 저장하고 무결성을 검증하는 서비스.

components.name: Magelis Authentication and Access Control Service
components.description: 사용자 인증, 역할 기반 권한 부여, 세션 관리를 처리하는 접근 제어 서비스.

components.name: Magelis Secure Boot and Attestation Module
components.description: 부팅 체인 무결성 측정과 서명 검증을 수행하는 보안 부트 모듈.

components.name: Modbus/TCP Protocol Stack
components.description: Modbus TCP 서버/클라이언트 기능. 레지스터 및 코일 접근 요청을 처리한다.

components.name: EtherNet/IP CIP Stack
components.description: EtherNet/IP 및 CIP 오브젝트 모델을 구현한 산업용 이더넷 스택.

components.name: OPC UA Server Stack
components.description: OPC UA 주소공간, 구독, 보안 채널을 제공하는 서버 스택.

vulnerabilities.description: The implementations of SAE in hostapd before 2.10 and wpa_supplicant before 2.10 are vulnerable to side channel attacks as a result of cache access patterns. NOTE: this issue exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2019-9494.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In the add_match function in libbb/lineedit.c in BusyBox through 1.27.2, the tab autocomplete feature of the shell, used to get a list of filenames in a directory, does not sanitize filenames and results in executing any escape sequence in the terminal. This could potentially result in code execution, arbitrary file writes, or other attacks.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: Busybox contains a Missing SSL certificate validation vulnerability in The "busybox wget" applet that can result in arbitrary code execution. This attack appear to be exploitable via Simply download any file over HTTPS using "busybox wget https://compromised-domain.com/important-file".

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: An issue was discovered in libxml2 before 2.10.3. Certain invalid XML entity definitions can corrupt a hash table key, potentially leading to subsequent logic errors. In one case, a double-free can be provoked.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: Integer overflow in the DHCP client (udhcpc) in BusyBox before 1.25.0 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via a malformed RFC1035-encoded domain name, which triggers an out-of-bounds heap write.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: A vulnerability was discovered in how p2p/p2p_pd.c in wpa_supplicant before 2.10 processes P2P (Wi-Fi Direct) provision discovery requests. It could result in denial of service or other impact (potentially execution of arbitrary code), for an attacker within radio range.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: A single-byte, non-arbitrary write/use-after-free flaw was found in dnsmasq. This flaw allows an attacker who sends a crafted packet processed by dnsmasq, potentially causing a denial of service.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: An issue was discovered in libxml2 before 2.10.3. When parsing a multi-gigabyte XML document with the XML_PARSE_HUGE parser option enabled, several integer counters can overflow. This results in an attempt to access an array at a negative 2GB offset, typically leading to a segmentation fault.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: An issue was discovered in Dnsmasq before 2.90. The default maximum EDNS.0 UDP packet size was set to 4096 but should be 1232 because of DNS Flag Day 2020.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In Mosquitto before 2.0.16, a memory leak occurs when clients send v5 CONNECT packets with a will message that contains invalid property types.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In libxml2 before 2.10.4, parsing of certain invalid XSD schemas can lead to a NULL pointer dereference and subsequently a segfault. This occurs in xmlSchemaFixupComplexType in xmlschemas.c.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In wpa_supplicant and hostapd 2.9, forging attacks may occur because AlgorithmIdentifier parameters are mishandled in tls/pkcs1.c and tls/x509v3.c.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.
